text: {"method":"Identify each major negative impact of monoculture farming on biodiversity and explain it in concise sentences, using a structured list of points; no arithmetic is required.","calculations":[],"keyPoints":["Reduces species richness by favoring a single crop species and eliminating habitat variety","Increases vulnerability to pests and diseases, leading to higher pesticide use that harms non‑target organisms","Depletes soil health and microbial diversity through repeated planting of the same crop","Promotes genetic erosion as local and wild varieties are displaced","Disrupts ecosystem services such as pollination, natural pest control, and nutrient cycling"]}

parsedContent.method: Identify each major negative impact of monoculture farming on biodiversity and explain it in concise sentences, using a structured list of points; no arithmetic is required.
keyPoints: Reduces species richness by favoring a single crop species and eliminating habitat variety
Increases vulnerability to pests and diseases, leading to higher pesticide use that harms non‑target organisms
Depletes soil health and microbial diversity through repeated planting of the same crop
Promotes genetic erosion as local and wild varieties are displaced
Disrupts ecosystem services such as pollination, natural pest control, and nutrient cycling
